note: Decatur County, KS (FIPS 20039) publishes no queryable zoning district service. The county GIS portals (gis-portal.org, parcelsearch.org, decaturcountypropertyappraiser.org) link no ArcGIS REST zoning layer; the county's parcel viewer is a qPublic/ORKA web map. The only zoning found from the county's city, Oberlin, is a 2017 PDF zoning map with no GIS layer. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and the Kansas GIS hub returned no Decatur County KS zoning service.
